description: Cash up front, fees, the reserve paid back and the APR on the cash received when an invoice is factored, from the advance rate, the fee schedule and the days until the customer pays.

added.description: Added fee per extra block of days, in percent of the invoice (optional)

advance.description: Advance rate in percent of the invoice, e.g. 80

block.description: Days in each extra block. Default 10

collect.description: Days until the customer pays, 1 to 730

fee.description: Factor fee for the first period, in percent of the invoice, e.g. 2

first.description: Days the first fee covers. Default 30

name: calculate_invoice_factoring_cost
title: Invoice factoring cost and APR
